articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Japan’s crypto security group taps SEAL to speed up hack response
articles.description: The partnership comes weeks after a third-party data breach exposed hundreds of thousands of customer email addresses belonging to two Japanese crypto exchanges.

articles.title: Ethereum devs set Glamsterdam’s Hoodi rollout for mid-December after delays
articles.description: Glamsterdam’s Hoodi upgrade was delayed in October after concerns that changes to gas pricing could break some existing smart contracts.

articles.title: AI is driving a flood of crypto bug reports. Now it’s helping sort them
articles.description: Bug bounty platform HackerOne said it’s increasing its triage throughput with AI agents after a record quarter of reports in the third quarter.

articles.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
articles.description: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

articles.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
articles.description: Netflix’s The Altruist has been slammed for its ‘very racist’ portrayal of CZ. BitMart reportedly has a $319.5 million shortfall and just $1.9M in liquid assets.

articles.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
articles.description: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
articles.description: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

articles.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase
articles.description: Coinbase and Stand With Crypto argue that the FCA’s proposed DeFi rules could leave UK users without regulated access to decentralized finance.

articles.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
articles.description: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

articles.title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
articles.description: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.

articles.title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’
articles.description: Economist Robin Brooks warned of dire consequences for stocks if the Federal Reserve fails to deliver dovish cues before the FOMC blackout period.

articles.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
articles.description: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

articles.title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
articles.description: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.description: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: 7 bizarre things crypto whales spent a fortune on
articles.description: The crypto rich have spent their fortunes on everything from dinosaur skeletons to rotting fruit, with some purchases defying belief.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin calls for verifiable chips as hardware wallet threats evolve
articles.description: Buterin warned that future attacks could use lookalike chips with hidden malicious functions, making hardware tampering harder to detect.

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
articles.description: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.

articles.title: Bitcoin price eyes $61K as Talos warns of thin Thanksgiving liquidity
articles.description: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in a modest relief rally as Talos questioned crypto demand and the broader outlook for the AI trade.

articles.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
articles.description: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
articles.description: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

articles.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
articles.description: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

articles.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
articles.description: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

articles.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
articles.description: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.

articles.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
articles.description: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

articles.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
articles.description: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

articles.title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
articles.description: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.

articles.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
articles.description: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.description: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

articles.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
articles.description: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.
